from itertools import product,permutations
colors='RBG'
objs='CMK' # coin marble key
init={'R':{'C'},'B':{'M'},'G':{'K'}}
sol=[]
# 3 direct moves stages 1,2,4; any moved obj at its stated source, src/dst colors multiset each 2 total
# contents swap R,G after second
for d1 in product(objs,colors,colors):
 o,s,d=d1
 if s==d or o not in init[s]: continue
 st={k:set(v) for k,v in init.items()};st[s].remove(o);st[d].add(o)
 for d2 in product(objs,colors,colors):
  o2,s2,d2c=d2
  if s2==d2c or o2 not in st[s2]: continue
  st2={k:set(v) for k,v in st.items()};st2[s2].remove(o2);st2[d2c].add(o2)
  st2['R'],st2['G']=st2['G'],st2['R']
  for d3 in product(objs,colors,colors):
   o3,s3,d3c=d3
   if s3==d3c or o3 not in st2[s3]: continue
   if sorted([s,d,s2,d2c,s3,d3c])"'!=sorted('"'RRBBGG'): continue
   st3={k:set(v) for k,v in st2.items()};st3[s3].remove(o3);st3[d3c].add(o3)
   # after: mover a into box currently containing target t, distinct objects, target unique
   for a,t in permutations(objs,2):
    src=[k for k,v in st3.items() if a in v][0]
    dest=[k for k,v in st3.items() if t in v][0]
    if src==dest: continue
    st4={k:set(v) for k,v in st3.items()};st4[src].remove(a);st4[dest].add(a)
    # object mention counts over d1,d2,d3,a, final f plus target t each total 2
    for f in objs:
     cnt={q:0 for q in objs}
     for q in (o,o2,o3,a,f,t):cnt[q]+=1
     if set(cnt.values())"'!={2}: continue
     empt=[k for k,v in st4.items() if not v]
     if len(empt)!=1: continue
     srcf=[k for k,v in st4.items() if f in v][0]
     if srcf==empt[0]: continue
     st5={k:set(v) for k,v in st4.items()};st5[srcf].remove(f);st5[empt[0]].add(f)
     # swap labels R/B: physical content labels permute. final visible: content at old R now B and old B now R
     final={'"'R':st5['B'],'B':st5['R'],'G':st5['G']}
     loc={q:k for k,v in final.items() for q in v}
     sol.append((d1,d2,d3,(a,t),f,loc,st5))
print('solutions',len(sol),'finals',len({tuple(sorted(x[5].items())) for x in sol}))
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(tuple(x[5][q] for q in 'MKC') for x in sol))
for x in sol[:30]:print(x[:6])

    if sa==dt:continue
    st4={k:set(v) for k,v in st.items()};st4[sa].remove(a);st4[dt].add(a)
    emp=[k for k,v in st4.items() if not v]
    if len(emp)"'!=1:continue
    for f in objs:
     if any([os.count(q)+(a==q)+(f==q)+(t==q)!=2 for q in objs]):continue
     sf=next(k for k,v in st4.items() if f in v)

     st5={k:set(v) for k,v in st4.items()};st5[sf].remove(f);st5[emp[0]].add(f)
